question_or_proposition: What constitutes 'trace amounts' of floating solids or visible foam for determining whether a discharge complies with or exceeds the limitation stated in this clause?
required_context: The nominated sentence: 'There shall be no discharge of floating solids or visible foam in other than trace amounts.'
Section header FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS
Adjacent sampling-location language on the same page specifying collection after treatment and prior to the receiving stream
notes: The clause sets a qualitative discharge limit keyed to an undefined 'trace amounts' threshold. Resolving its meaning affects whether visual or qualitative observations constitute exceedance under Purpose A and how non-numeric or missing-evidence cases are classified under Purpose C. The nominated span does not itself establish monitoring frequency, so Purpose B is not directly affected.
